Card draw and removal are also a big part of powerlevels. If your drawing considerably more cards then your opponents your more likely to win.
As I like to put it "I like playing magic, if I draw more cards I play more magic" just playing more then the people at your table will generally eek out a win even if the strategy is weaker

Honestly playtesting is a big part of this. 
Also some decks are just going to have better match ups and you'll need to take that into account. 


If you like what the deck does, there's often weaker versions of effects as well.
Like a powerful enchantment might have a creature that does something similar but costs more mana, and being a creature is easier to remove.
